summary_md: **小满 ([@the123456ai](https://x.com/the123456ai/status/2116523157842718915))** introduces **EdgeRock-4B**, derived from Qwen3.5-4B, which keeps the last 1,024 tokens in full and compresses older context into a fixed memory bank, holding KV cache at 72 MiB; self-reported AIME 24–26 mean is 82.9% vs 86.1% for the base; not yet runnable in Ollama ([rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock](https://huggingface.co/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock)).
relevance: Constant-memory long reasoning for small local models.
